" 
When you use a Torve account, the service processes your email address, account identifier, password hash and authentication sessions. Account-backed features synchronize supported settings, favorites, watch history and playback progress. Device identifiers, names and connection information support synchronization and device management. 
 
Credentials selected for account storage are encrypted on Torve's servers and can be restored to signed-in devices. Device-only credentials remain on that device where this storage option is offered."
